publications.name: AlphaChimp: Tracking and Behavior Recognition of Chimpanzees
publications.summary: We propose AlphaChimp, an end-to-end approach that simultaneously detects chimpanzee positions and estimates behavior categories from videos.

publications.name: CLONE: Holistic Closed-Loop Humanoid Whole-Body Teleoperation for Long-Horizon Tasks
publications.summary: CLONE employs an MoE-based policy with closed-loop error correction for holistic humanoid teleoperation, enabling capabilities previously unattainable with existing systems—such as whole-body coordination and long-horizon task execution.

publications.name: COLA: Learning Human-Humanoid Coordination for Collaborative Object Carrying
publications.publisher: International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2026
publications.summary: COLA is trained in a closed-loop environment with dynamic object interactions to predict object motion patterns and human intentions implicitly, enabling compliant collaboration to maintain load balance through coordinated trajectory planning.

publications.name: LessMimic: Long-Horizon Humanoid Interaction with Unified Distance Field Representations
publications.summary: A whole-body humanoid policy conditioned on distance-field geometric cues for reference-free interaction, long-horizon skill composition, and vision-only deployment without motion capture.

publications.name: OmniClone: Engineering a Robust, All-Rounder Whole-Body Humanoid Teleoperation System
publications.summary: A whole-body humanoid teleoperation system with robust multi-skill control, the OmniBench diagnostic benchmark, and subject-agnostic retargeting for scalable humanoid control and learning.

publications.name: GapONet: Nonlinear Operator Learning for Bridging the Humanoid Sim-to-Real Gap
publications.publisher: NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Embodiment-Aware World Models (EWM)
publications.summary: A payload-conditioned nonlinear operator that maps simulation context functions to residual actions for hardware, keeping large sim-to-real gaps below 0.09% when tracking unseen motions.
